description: Read-only static AST audit of every subprocess / shell-out / direct-process call site under scripts/. Classifies 308 sites across 8 closed-set buckets: HARDENED_COMPILER_PATH, HIVE_SANDBOXED_PATH, LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY, LEGACY_EXEMPT_TEST_FIXTURE, MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER, BLOCKED_UNSAFE, PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE, UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW. Inventory only — this rung does NOT migrate any execution path.
purpose: Rung 4 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Closes the gap-to-100 audit's hidden-assumption #3 ('parallel execution layers; only one hardened'). The output is the target list for HARDENED_INTAKE_EXECUTION_RUNNER_LOCK_001 (the next rung). Audit is intentionally read-only: never executes a discovered command, never mutates source or signed evidence, never imports the scanned modules.
headline_findings: BLOCKED_UNSAFE: 0 — no shell=True or raw os.system call survived the scan inside Claude-lane code paths.
HARDENED_COMPILER_PATH: 10 — every subprocess inside hive/compiler.py is part of the documented sandboxed oracle (Job Object + Docker backend + WSL2 backend).

MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER: 10 sites across scripts/codebase_explorer.py (ShadowCompiler), scripts/intake/build_adapters.py (BuildAdapter._run + per-adapter shadow builds), and scripts/repair/. These are the explicit target list for the next rung.

UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW: 121 — top-level scripts/ helpers (determinex_benchmark, determinex_fullbench, micro_eval, swe_run/repo.py, hardware_profiler, etc.). Each needs a human triage decision; the audit deliberately does not silently classify them.
PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE: 56 — Codex-trail files (scripts/corpus/programbench/, scripts/pb_*, scripts/determinex_programbench*, scripts/corpus/legacy_recovery/) explicitly bypassed per directive.
LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY: 37 — validators (DATA ENGINE ONLY), dev tools, agent helpers, CLI dispatcher, doctor/status/setup/settings.
top_must_migrate_targets: scripts/codebase_explorer.py — ShadowCompiler subprocess calls + per-file py_compile loop
scripts/intake/build_adapters.py — BuildAdapter._run + per-adapter shadow build (cargo check, go build, npm run build, mvn compile, gradle compileJava, py_compile)
scripts/repair/*.py — repair-pipeline executors (PYTHON_REPAIR_LOCK_001, RUST_REPAIR_LOCK_001, GO_REPAIR_LOCK_001, TYPESCRIPT_REPAIR_LOCK_001, JAVA_REPAIR_LOCK_001, NATIVE_C_CPP_REPAIR_LOCK_001)
invariants: Audit is read-only — verified by test_audit_does_not_call_subprocess_during_scan (monkeypatches subprocess.run/Popen to raise; audit completes without invoking them).
Audit does not mutate scripts/ tree — verified by hash-tree before/after.
Audit does not mutate signed evidence (evidence_index.json + locks/sentinel/*.json) — verified by SHA-256 before/after.
Audit does not write corpus rows (DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE active during tests; CorpusWriteBlockedError raised on attempted write).
BLOCKED_UNSAFE count is pinned at 0; any future change introducing a shell=True / os.system call in Claude-lane code flips test_lock_manifest_pins_zero_blocked_unsafe red.
All execution sites in scripts/hive/compiler.py classify as HARDENED_COMPILER_PATH.
All execution sites in scripts/codebase_explorer.py classify as MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER (legacy ShadowCompiler path).
All execution sites in scripts/intake/build_adapters.py classify as MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER (new BuildAdapter._run path).
All ProgramBench-trail files (scripts/corpus/programbench/, scripts/pb_*, scripts/determinex_programbench*, scripts/programbench_*) classify as PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE; Claude does not touch them.
Unknown sites (no classification rule matched) classify as UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW — never silently accepted as backed or hardened.
Doc counts table contains '| <CLS> | <N> |' rows that match the runtime audit's counts_by_classification dict.
No DETERMINEX_*/HF_HOME/OLLAMA_* env var required for the audit to run.
Safety defaults remain fail-closed after the audit runs.
deliberately_out_of_scope: tests/ tree — only scripts/ scanned this rung. tests/ shell-out is generally LEGACY_EXEMPT_TEST_FIXTURE; will be added when needed.
Bash (.sh) and PowerShell (.ps1) scripts — Python-only AST audit this rung; shell-language scanning is a future extension.
Dockerfile RUN directives — out of scope; CI evidence-validation job handles those.
Tauri Rust IPC handlers (frontend/src-tauri/src/*.rs) — Rust audit is a separate effort.
No execution-path migration — this rung is inventory only. HARDENED_INTAKE_EXECUTION_RUNNER_LOCK_001 (rung 5) consumes the must-migrate list.
remaining_gaps: 121 UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW sites are unclassified by design — they need human triage. Top files: scripts/swe_run/repo.py (12), scripts/hardware_profiler.py (7), scripts/determinex_fullbench.py (6), scripts/micro_eval.py (6), scripts/setup_swebench.py (6). Triage results will inform whether each file becomes LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY, MUST_MIGRATE, or moves to a separate Claude-lane / Codex-lane partition.

Bare imported call sites (`from subprocess import Popen; Popen(...)`) detect Popen but the audit conservatively does NOT flag bare `run(...)` because the identifier is too ambiguous without import-tracking. This is a known coverage gap; very few files do this.

shell=True is flagged on ANY call, not just subprocess.* — that is intentional (precision-over-recall), but could produce false positives on user-defined functions named `shell=True`. Currently zero false positives observed (BLOCKED_UNSAFE count is 0).

Validators classification is path-based; if a validator file ever invokes user payload, the path-based exemption would be wrong. Future work: add a content-based check (e.g., 'this validator never calls subprocess on user-provided argv').
PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE is path-based; if a non-PB script imports a PB module that itself shells out, the audit reports the PB module's sites, not the importer. Acceptable for this rung.
